dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Strongly concave (falcate) spline following the trailing edge, interrupted by significant irregular notching and tissue loss near the terminal apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Highly irregular and jagged shape classification due to acquired notches; the original rounded or acute peak is replaced by multiple small pixel-radius indentations.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Moderately steep convex curvature originating from the dorsal ridge at approximately a 40-degree incline relative to the horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximate 1.3:1 ratio of maximum base chord width to vertical height from the dorsal midline.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent V-shaped and irregular notches along the upper trailing edge and apex of the dorsal fin; large, dark, complex-shaped mark or lesion on the lateral flank below the fin's anterior insertion point.
